title: Exploring Ketamine's Effects on Depression and Anxiety in Adults With Low Vision
official: Exploring Ketamine's Effects on Depression and Anxiety in Adults With Low Vision
summary: The purpose of this open-label study is to evaluate the effects of a single intravenous infusion of ketamine on depression and anxiety in adults with low vision.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria for Participants with Low Vision:

* Ages 18 and older
* Qualifies as a low vision participant based on ophthalmology assessments
* Capacity to provide informed consent

Inclusion Criteria for Healthy Controls:

* Ages 18 and older
* Qualifies as a normal vision participant based on ophthalmology assessments
* Capacity to provide informed consent
* Likely able to tolerate clinical study procedures
* No current or lifetime psychiatric diagnosis
* No current or past use of psychotropic medication

Exclusion Criteria for Participants with Low Vision and Healthy Controls:

* allergy to ketamine
* Any current or past medical/psychiatric condition that makes participation unsafe in the opinion of the investigator or study physician
* Pregnant or nursing, or able to become pregnant and are not practicing an effective means of birth control
